result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page: one major layout truncation issue and one minor card clipping issue.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off/truncated, suggesting the card or text container is too narrow to display the full name.
issues.suggestion: Either widen the card width, reduce the font size, or implement proper text truncation with ellipsis and ensure the full name is accessible via tooltip or on tap.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is partially clipped at the right edge of the screen, with no visual affordance (like a shadow or partial peek) clearly indicating it is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a more obvious visual cue such as a subtle shadow or ensure a consistent peek width so users understand the list is horizontally scrollable.
